packages.name: ca-certificates
packages.summary: Trust store for HTTPS clients, ACME, package mirrors, Git, database clients, and language runtimes.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and cat /usr/share/certs/swiftos-ca-bundle.version in QEMU
packages.notes: Data-only package; current canonical packaged cert path is /usr/etc/ssl/cert.pem until base links or non-/usr package paths are supported.

packages.name: tzdata
packages.summary: Time zone data for logs, databases, TLS validation, and language runtimes.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and cat /usr/share/zoneinfo/swiftos-tzdata.version in QEMU
packages.notes: Data-only package; scripts/build-tzdata.sh compiles IANA TZif files with host zic and packages the full /usr/share/zoneinfo tree plus metadata.

packages.name: zlib
packages.upstream: zlib-ng in zlib-compat mode or classic zlib
packages.summary: Compression library used by TLS stacks, Git, nginx, PostgreSQL, PNG/tools, and many archives.
packages.smokeTest: compress and decompress a known string and verify SHA-256 of the output
packages.notes: Good first runtime dependency exercise for static libraries and pkgconf metadata.

packages.name: zstd
packages.summary: Modern compression library and CLI for packages, archives, and backups.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and pipe a known string through zstd -q -c | zstd -q -dc in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged as a single-threaded static zstd/unzstd/zstdcat CLI, libzstd.a, headers, pkgconf metadata, and a version marker. gzip/lzma/lz4 support remains disabled until those dependencies are packaged.

packages.name: bzip2
packages.summary: Legacy archive support required by many upstream distfiles.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and pipe a known string through bzip2 -c | bzip2 -dc in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged as static bzip2/bunzip2/bzcat/bzip2recover tools, libbz2.a, bzlib.h, pkgconf metadata, and a version marker. Useful for later libarchive coverage.

packages.name: xz
packages.summary: .xz and liblzma support for upstream source tarballs and packages.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and pipe a known string through xz -q -c | xz -q -dc in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged from the signed upstream release track after the XZ supply-chain incident. scripts/build-xz.sh cross-builds a static small xz/unxz/xzcat CLI, liblzma.a, headers, pkgconf metadata, and a version marker with NLS, scripts, sandboxing, threading, assembler, and dynamic libraries disabled.

packages.name: openssl
packages.summary: Command-line TLS tool for HTTPS, certs, curl, nginx, OpenSSH, and tests.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository, run openssl version, and hash a known string with openssl dgst -sha256 in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged as OpenSSL 3.5 LTS with the static openssl CLI and a version marker. Static libssl/libcrypto development artifacts are deferred to an openssl-dev split package so the runtime package stays installable in the current tmpfs-backed bootstrap. Shared libraries, DSO/modules, threads, async, engines, docs, tests, assembly, secure memory, and Linux/devcrypto engines are disabled for the first package.

packages.name: pcre2
packages.summary: Regex library needed by nginx, many text tools, and scripting runtimes.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and run pcre2grep against known nginx/lighttpd patterns in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged as static libpcre2-8, libpcre2-posix, headers, pkgconf metadata, and pcre2grep. JIT and pcre2grep recursive directory traversal are disabled until executable mappings/W^X and the dirent libc surface are ready.

packages.name: libarchive
packages.summary: Unified tar, cpio, and archive extraction for ports tooling and target admin use.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository, run bsdtar --version, create a tiny tar, and list it in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged as static bsdtar, libarchive.a, public headers, pkgconf metadata, and a marker file. The first SwiftOS build links against packaged zlib, bzip2, zstd, and xz roots while disabling bsdcat, bsdcpio, bsdunzip, ACL/xattr, external program filters at runtime, iconv, lz4, lzo2, libb2, OpenSSL, XML backends, and POSIX regex.

packages.name: curl
packages.summary: HTTP(S) client for admin workflows, diagnostics, package repo debugging, and scripts.
packages.smokeTest: start a host HTTP server in QEMU, run curl http://server/file, and compare content
packages.notes: Prefer HTTP/HTTPS only at first; disable unused protocols.

packages.name: lua
packages.summary: Small scripting runtime and ideal first real source port after pkghello.
packages.smokeTest: lua -e 'print(_VERSION)'
packages.notes: Build static; disable dynamic C modules until loader policy exists.

packages.name: oksh
packages.summary: Small interactive admin shell with a friendlier experience than minimal sh.
packages.smokeTest: oksh -c 'echo ok && pwd'
packages.notes: Job control can stay disabled until process groups are ready.

packages.name: ncurses
packages.summary: Terminal UI library for editors, pagers, shells, and midnight commander.
packages.smokeTest: run a tiny curses program that initializes and exits cleanly
packages.notes: Terminfo data path must be stable for all terminal UI packages.

packages.name: less
packages.summary: Pager for logs, docs, SQL output, and diagnostics.
packages.smokeTest: printf 'a\nb\n' | less -F exits successfully
packages.notes: Can use termcap or ncurses depending on the first terminal stack choice.

packages.name: mc
packages.summary: File manager, viewer, editor, and diff tool for serial or SSH admin work.
packages.smokeTest: mc --version and later scripted start in a pseudo-terminal
packages.notes: Disable subshell, VFS plugins, and network filesystems in the first build.

packages.name: lighttpd
packages.summary: First practical HTTP daemon candidate before nginx if a smaller C server is useful.
packages.smokeTest: serve /var/www/index.html and fetch it from the host
packages.notes: Disable dynamic modules and optional CGI/FastCGI features initially.

packages.name: nginx
packages.summary: Minimal static HTTP-only nginx web server for swift-os.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository, run nginx -v, and read the packaged web root marker
packages.notes: Packaged first as an HTTP-only static binary with poll events, no dynamic modules, no TLS, no rewrite, no gzip, and no proxy module. TLS, pcre2 rewrite support, gzip, reverse proxying, and service-supervisor integration remain follow-up web-stack packages.

packages.name: acme-sh
packages.summary: Shell-based ACME client and likely easiest Let's Encrypt path before Go/Python clients.
packages.smokeTest: complete HTTP-01 challenge against Pebble using a temporary webroot
packages.notes: Script package that requires a capable POSIX shell and external tools.

packages.name: sqlite
packages.summary: Static SQLite library and sqlite3 command-line shell for tools, package metadata experiments, small apps, and smoke tests.
packages.smokeTest: install from the seed repository and run sqlite3 -batch -noheader -cmd '.mode list' :memory: 'select 6*7;' in QEMU
packages.notes: Packaged as a static sqlite3 shell, libsqlite3.a, headers, pkgconf metadata, and version marker. The first smoke test uses :memory: because durable database files wait on persistent storage and locking policy.

packages.name: postgresql-client
packages.summary: psql, pg_dump, and client library before the server port lands.
packages.smokeTest: connect from QEMU to a host PostgreSQL server and run select 1
packages.notes: Disable LDAP, PAM, GSSAPI, and dynamic plugin assumptions first.

packages.name: postgresql-server
packages.summary: Primary serious open-source relational database target.
packages.smokeTest: initdb on persistent disk, start server, psql -c 'select 1', reboot, and query again
packages.notes: Static server is possible but extension loading, locale, and multi-process behavior are hard.

packages.name: mariadb-client
packages.summary: MySQL-compatible client and library before the server port lands.
packages.smokeTest: connect to a host MariaDB server and run select 1
packages.notes: Authentication plugins must be built in or limited.

packages.name: mariadb-server
packages.summary: MySQL-compatible database for common web hosting stacks.
packages.smokeTest: initialize datadir, start server, mysql -e 'select 1', reboot, and verify table persists
packages.notes: Start with a minimal engine set and no dynamic plugins.

packages.name: nodejs
packages.summary: JavaScript server runtime for modern web apps and tooling.
packages.smokeTest: node -e 'require("http").createServer((_,r)=>r.end("ok")).listen(8080)'
packages.notes: The first SwiftOS Node.js port uses Node's --v8-lite-mode as the accepted jitless profile, avoiding a runtime executable-code dependency for V8. Native addons are deferred until dynamic loading policy exists. Dedicated probes cover worker-thread eventfd wakeups over poll, the pthread barrier branch selected by libuv, timed condition waits with CLOCK_MONOTONIC deadlines, and AF_UNIX socketpair local streams used by libuv process/stream paths; full libuv audit remains the runtime blocker.

packages.name: npm
packages.summary: JavaScript package manager for the SwiftOS Node.js runtime.
packages.smokeTest: npm --version, then install a pure-JS package into /tmp/npm-prefix
packages.notes: Package npm separately from nodejs so the immutable root, /tmp cache, registry access, and native-addon decisions stay explicit.

packages.name: pm2
packages.summary: Node.js process manager for SwiftOS-hosted services.
packages.smokeTest: pm2-runtime start /tmp/app.js --no-daemon and fetch the app from the host
packages.notes: Start with pm2-runtime/no-daemon against one app. Cluster mode, startup generation, file watching, and durable process lists wait for service and storage policy.

packages.name: openjdk-runtime
packages.summary: JVM target for Java services and long-horizon project goals.
packages.smokeTest: java -version, then run HelloWorld.class
packages.notes: Headless runtime first; JNI native libraries are deferred.

packages.name: swift-runtime-minimal
packages.upstream: Swift project plus swift-os ABI support
packages.summary: Runtime support for native Swift server apps compiled off-target.
packages.smokeTest: run a statically linked Swift hello and a tiny TCP echo server
packages.notes: Prefer statically linked app packages first; full standard library comes later.
